Anycast.Description: AS uses anycast for at least one IP address.

Tranco 10k Host.Description: AS hosts domains in the Tranco top domains list.

IPv6 Only.Description: AS originates IPv6 prefixes but no IPv4 prefixes.

No Eyeball.Description: AS has no inferred eyeballs (end users).

No Transit.Description: AS does not provide IP transit at all.
No Transit.Logic: For a given AS, it does not have any ASes as customers.

Sibling Transit.Description: AS only carries traffic internally within its organization to its sibling ASes.
Sibling Transit.Logic: For a given AS, all direct customer ASes are its sibling ASes.

Public Transit.Description: AS provides IP transit service to ASes owned by other downstream organizations.
Public Transit.Logic: For a given AS, some direct customer ASes are not its sibling ASes.

Any Presence.Description: Returns list of country codes where AS has any IP presence (IPv4 or IPv6).
Any Presence.Logic: Union of country codes from maxmind-geolite2_cc_v4_list and cc_v6_list.

Domestic.Description: Domestic AS. Defined by Gamero-Garrido, Alexander, et al. 'Quantifying nations' exposure to traffic observation and selective tampering.' PAM 2022.
Domestic.Logic: An AS originates at least two-thirds of its IP addresses geolocated in the given country.

Major Access.Description: Major access AS. Defined by Carisimo, Esteban, et al. 'Identifying ASes of state-owned internet operators.' IMC 2021.
Major Access.Logic: An AS originates more than 5% of the country's globally routed IP addresses.

Global Transit Nth-ranked.Description: Global transit significance ranking using Borda count aggregation over 5 transit metrics.
Global Transit Nth-ranked.Logic: Aggregate Borda point rankings from: customer_cnt, cone_/24_cnt, cone_/64_cnt, global_hege_v4, global_hege_v6. Lower rank = more significant.
